playbookOutputs: Company tax computation reconciled to the AFS
ITR14 submitted on eFiling with submission confirmation
Note on tax payable / refund and provisional tax top-up
playbookCommonFailures: AFS not signed or the AFS year-end does not match the SARS financial year on the profile
Trial balance/AFS figures do not reconcile to the VAT201 turnover already declared for the year
Company is required to submit AFS with the return (turnover band / audited) and the PDF is missing
Public officer not appointed or profile not activated for Income Tax on eFiling
Prior-year assessed loss not carried forward correctly, or IRP6 payments missing on the assessment

informationToProvide.label: Company Name, Registration Number & Tax Year
informationToProvide.helpText: Registered company name, CIPC registration number, 10-digit SARS Income Tax number, and the tax year to be filed.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Company name, CIPC number, SARS Income Tax reference number, and financial year-end.

informationToProvide.label: Signed Annual Financial Statements (AFS)
informationToProvide.helpText: Audited, independently reviewed, or compiled Annual Financial Statements (AFS) signed by the directors for the tax year.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Signed Annual Financial Statements (AFS) for the company covering the tax year.

informationToProvide.label: Final Trial Balance or Management Accounts (if separate from AFS)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload the final trial balance or management accounts if not already included in the AFS pack.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Trial balance or management accounts for the relevant tax period.

informationToProvide.label: Company Bank Statements for the Financial Year
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload full-year company bank statements (used if SARS selects the ITR14 for verification).
informationToProvide.aiHint: Company bank statements for the financial year.

informationToProvide.label: Previous Year ITR14 / ITA34 Assessment (if new client)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload the prior year ITA34 assessment to verify assessed loss brought forward and wear-and-tear allowances.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Prior year SARS ITA34 assessment or ITR14 return.

informationToProvide.label: SARS eFiling Username
informationToProvide.helpText: Your SARS eFiling login username (or confirm if My Accountant already has Registered Representative / Tax Practitioner shared access).
informationToProvide.aiHint: SARS eFiling username for the taxpayer profile or confirmation of shared Tax Practitioner access.

informationToProvide.label: SARS eFiling Password
informationToProvide.helpText: Encrypted and restricted to authorized filing staff and the SARS eFiling automation worker.

informationToProvide.label: SARS eFiling OTP Required? (Yes / No)
informationToProvide.helpText: Does logging into your SARS eFiling profile trigger a One-Time PIN (OTP) to your cellphone or email?
informationToProvide.aiHint: Whether 2FA OTP relay is required when logging into SARS eFiling.

informationToProvide.label: Best Time to Contact for SARS OTP
informationToProvide.helpText: Select a date and time window when you will be available to relay the real-time SARS OTP within the 10-minute eFiling timeout.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Preferred date/time window to coordinate real-time SARS eFiling OTP relay.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect eFiling access, AFS and supporting financials
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Signed AFS (or TB + management accounts), prior-year assessment and eFiling credentials on file
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Ask for the signed AFS by name and explain the ITR14 is completed from them. Confirm the financial year-end and which year is being filed. Do not promise a turnaround shorter than 1–2 working days.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Verify AFS match the company and year
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: AFS entity name, registration number and year-end match the SARS profile; AFS are signed
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Entity is the company. Check the year-end against the SARS financial year (mismatch means a change of year-end must be registered first — raise a proposal). Check the AFS are for the right year and signed. Cross-check turnover to VAT201s filed for the year where the company is a VAT vendor.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Prepare the company tax computation
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Tax computation reconciles accounting profit to taxable income and Kevin has reviewed it
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Pull from the AI Accountant module: accounting profit, add back non-deductible items (depreciation, provisions, penalties, donations above limit), deduct wear-and-tear (IN47), s12 allowances, assessed loss b/f, exempt income (local dividends). Apply the 27% rate (or SBC tables if the company qualifies — Kevin decides SBC status). Deduct IRP6 payments made. ⚠ verify current rate, SBC thresholds and IN47 periods.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Draft tax computation and ITR14 handoff sheet
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Handoff sheet lists every ITR14 section value (company info, balance sheet, income statement, tax computation, contributed capital, dormancy answers)
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: The ITR14 is long: map AFS balance sheet and income statement lines to the ITR14 financial fields (the layout differs by turnover band — micro / small / medium-large). Note whether AFS must be attached (⚠ verify: required for companies above the small-business turnover band / where the return asks). List directors and shareholding for the "company structure" section.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Complete and submit the ITR14 on eFiling
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: ITR14 submitted; confirmation and summary screenshot saved; AFS uploaded where required
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Returns Issued → Income Tax (ITR14) → select the year. Answer the wizard (dormant = No, trading = Yes, turnover band) from the handoff sheet, complete financial sections, tax computation section and upload the AFS PDF if required. Agent drives to the summary; Kevin reviews and presses Submit. eFiling login from a new device/IP triggers an OTP to the taxpayer's registered cell/email: pause, raise an otpRequest on the portal job via the OTP relay (Kevin, or the client through the Communication History link if allowed), 10-minute timeout then fail cleanly and reschedule. Never store OTPs. If a CAPTCHA appears, fall back to hand-off mode with the handoff sheet. Prefer filing from our practitioner profile if the taxpayer is already linked as a client; otherwise use the client's own login. If the taxpayer is not registered for the tax type on eFiling, stop and raise a proposal — do not activate tax types without Kevin. If the company is not activated for Income Tax or has no public officer, stop and raise a proposal.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Wait for ITA34 and handle verification
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: ITA34 received or verification documents uploaded
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: If SARS issues a verification letter, propose the bundle (AFS, tax computation, TB, IRP6 proof) for Kevin and upload via eFiling within the window on the letter (⚠ verify: 21 business days).

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver ITA34, computation and outcome note
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: ITA34, computation and plain-English note posted to Communication History
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: State the tax payable and due date on the ITA34 (PRN for payment via eFiling/EFT), or the refund. Remind the client the next IRP6 estimate should be based on this assessment and offer the IRP6 service.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Final sign-off
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Kevin confirms the order can be completed
